test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: By selling an article for ₹19, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 50%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = ₹19

Profit = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + Profit%)

Increase in SP = SPₙₑw - SP

**Calculation:**

Profit = 10%

CP = 19 / (1 + 10/100)

CP = 19 / 1.1

CP = 17.27 (rounded to two decimal places)

New Profit = 50%

SPₙₑw = 17.27 × (1 + 50/100)

SPₙₑw = 17.27 × 1.5

SPₙₑw = 25.91 (rounded to two decimal places)

Increase in SP = SPₙₑw - SP

Increase in SP = 25.91 - 19

Increase in SP = 6.91

**The correct answer is option 3.**

73
